title: Name each skill's point of failure
statement: Break each standard into components that each name one point of failure, the error a student makes when it fails, and the kind of knowledge it depends on.
example: One Grade 3 set splits its standards into 86 components, each linked to one of six knowledge categories.
detail: A Grade 3 standards workbook describes each component as a single point of failure, records the error a child makes when it fails, for instance calling a vivid detail the main idea, and links each to a knowledge category (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Curriculum maps/G3 Standards and Standard components.xlsx`). A count made in this run found 86 components and six knowledge categories on its one sheet. It is a design; no outcome was measured.
